chunks: Several of our companions from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Abu Hamza al-Thumali, from Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) who said:
The most pleasing of you to God is the one who is most generous toward his dependants.

key_terms.أَرْضَاكُمْ: The one most pleasing to God; from radiya (to be pleased/satisfied); implies divine approval and acceptance
key_terms.أَسْبَغُكُمْ: The most generous/liberal; from sabagha (to be ample, full, complete); conveys abundant provision without stinginess
key_terms.عِيَال: Dependants; those under one's financial care and responsibility, especially wife and children

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Zayn al-Abidin say about generosity toward one's family?
ai.summary: Imam Ali ibn al-Husayn Zayn al-Abidin (peace be upon him), the fourth Imam, taught that one's standing before God is directly proportional to one's generosity and liberality toward those in one's care. The term 'ayal (عِيَال) refers specifically to those one is legally and morally obligated to provide for — wife, children, and household dependants. This teaching reframes divine approval not through abstract piety but through concrete domestic responsibility, addressing an audience for whom the family unit was the foundation of social and spiritual life.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Malik Bin Atiyya, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly, 
(It has been narrated) from Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The ones of you most Pleased with in the Presence of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, is the one most liberal bestower upon his dependants’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ahmad ibn Muhammad all from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from Malik ibn ‘Atiyyah from abu Hamzah al-Thumaliy who has said the following: “Ali ibn al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said,
’Of the people among you with whom Allah is most happy, is the one who improves the quality of life of his family the most.”
